reviews.title: All the power I need
reviews.comment:
This power supply has a complete set of connections for anything I could want to do. It has everything you would expect: motherboard, motherboard 12V, two PCIe power (6+2), lots of SATA and Molex power. The lengths of the wires are fine, the connectors on each wire are just flexible enough, which is good. No one wants a brittle power connector.
It's very quiet, even when I'm using the CPU and GPU at full power. That makes sense, since my whole machine only pulls at most about 500 watts, only half of what this PSU can produce. I definitely can't hear the PSU over the GPU noise.
Installation was easy, the most time consuming part is cable management, as usual. I prefer the non-modular style of this power supply, because it means that I don't have a big wad of cables I need to keep forever in a drawer.
reviews.author: David Heigl
